section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物技术基因检测装置，包括机体，所述机体的表面固定连接有控制器，所述机体的右侧固定连接有检测仓，所述检测仓内腔的底部开设有安装槽，所述安装槽内腔底部的右侧固定连接有安装座，所述安装座的顶部固定连接有伺服电机，所述伺服电机的输出轴固定连接有齿轮，所述齿轮的顶部啮合有齿板。本实用新型通过机体、控制器、检测仓、安装槽、安装座、伺服电机、齿轮、齿板、放置板、放置架、容纳腔、深槽、弹簧、夹持板、插槽、插柱和螺栓的配合使用，能够自动的将放置板送出，且能够根据需要对放置架进行快速的更换，从而能够对不同大小的试样进行检测，给基因检测工作带来了极大的便利。

The utility model discloses a biotechnology gene detection device, which comprises a bod, the fixed surface of organism is connected with the controller, the right side fixedly connected with of organism detects the storehouse, the mounting groove has been seted up to the bottom that detects the storehouse inner chamber, the right side fixedly connected with mount pad of mounting groove inner chamber bottom, the top fixedly connected with servo motor of mount pad, servo motor's output shaft fixedly connected with gear, the top meshing of gear has the pinion rack. The utility model discloses an organism, controller, detection storehouse, mounting groove, mount pad, servo motor, gear, pinion rack, place board, rack, hold chamber, deep trouth, spring, grip block, slot, the cooperation of inserting post and bolt is used, can be automatic will place the board and see off, and can carry out quick change to the rack as required to can detect the sample of equidimension not, brought very big facility for gene detection work.

Biotechnological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a biotechnology gene detection device.

Background

The gene detection is a technology for detecting DNA through blood, other body fluids or cells, after the peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person are taken and amplified, DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person is detected through specific equipment, and various conditions of genes contained in the cells are analyzed, so that people can know the own gene information, the pathogeny is determined, or the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease is predicted.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biotechnology gene testing device possesses convenient to use's advantage, has solved present gene testing device and can not be quick go up unloading, and can not fix the sample of equidimension not to the problem of its practicality has been reduced.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a biotechnology gene detection device, includes the organism, the fixed surface of organism is connected with the controller, the right side fixedly connected with of organism detects the storehouse, the mounting groove has been seted up to the bottom of detecting the storehouse inner chamber, the right side fixedly connected with mount pad of mounting groove inner chamber bottom, the top fixedly connected with servo motor of mount pad, servo motor's output shaft fixedly connected with gear, the top meshing of gear has the pinion rack, the board is placed to the top fixedly connected with of pinion rack, the top of placing the board is provided with the rack, the top of rack has been seted up and has been held the chamber, the inner chamber both sides top and the bottom that hold the chamber have all been seted up the deep groove, the inner chamber fixedly connected with spring of deep groove, the other end fixedly connected with grip block of spring, the slot has all been seted up to the both sides of rack bottom, the inner chamber of slot is provided with the inserted column, the bottom of inserted column and the top fixed connection who places the board, the equal threaded connection in both sides at rack top has the bolt, the bottom of bolt and the top threaded connection of inserted column.

Preferably, the surface of the detection bin is movably connected with a bin door through a hinge, and the surface of the bin door is provided with a catching groove.

Preferably, place the left side fixedly connected with limiting plate of board bottom, the inner chamber of limiting plate runs through and is provided with spacing post, the left end of spacing post and the inner wall fixed connection of mounting groove, the right-hand member fixedly connected with fixed plate of spacing post, the bottom of fixed plate and the bottom fixed connection of mounting groove inner chamber.

Preferably, the clamping plates are designed in a semicircular shape, and rubber pads are fixedly connected to the opposite sides of the two clamping plates.

Preferably, first threaded holes are formed in the two sides of the top of the placing frame, and second threaded holes are formed in the top of the inserting column.

Preferably, the inner cavity of the limiting plate is provided with a limiting hole, and the limiting hole is connected with the limiting column in a sliding manner.

Preferably, both sides at placing frame top are all fixedly connected with the handle, and the handle is the design of soft rope.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

1. the utility model discloses an organism, controller, detection storehouse, mounting groove, mount pad, servo motor, gear, pinion rack, place board, rack, hold chamber, deep trouth, spring, grip block, slot, the cooperation of inserting post and bolt is used, can be automatic will place the board and see off, and can carry out quick change to the rack as required to can detect the sample of equidimension not, brought very big facility for gene detection work.

2. The utility model discloses a set up limiting plate, spacing post and fixed plate, can carry out spacing fixed to placing the board, guaranteed the stability of its back-and-forth movement, through setting up the rubber pad, can guarantee the integrality of sample bottle.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative efforts all belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

The components of the utility model are all universal standard components or components known by the technicians in the field, and the structure and the principle of the components are all known by the technicians through technical manuals or through conventional experimental methods.

During the use, after opening the storehouse door, through the work of controller 2 control servo motor 6, servo motor 6 drives gear 7 and rotates, gear 7 drives pinion rack 8 and removes, pinion rack 8 drives and places board 9 and removes, it drives and places board 9 and removes the inner chamber that detects storehouse 3 to place board 9, can take off this moment or place the sample bottle can holding the inner chamber of chamber 11, it is fixed to carry out the centre gripping through spring 13 and grip block 14 to the sample bottle simultaneously, when needs change rack 10, make it and insert the separation of post 16 through rotating bolt 17, rack 10 can be taken off this moment, then it can to change the rack 10 that accords with the demand again.
